lemmas.primary_translation: in combat / in the midst of the conflict / (be next in line to) take part in a tough test or competition

definitions.translation: in the midst of the conflict

examples.no: jeg er soldat og har vært i ilden før
examples.en: I am a soldier and have been in combat before

definitions.text: (stå for tur til å) være med i hard prøve eller konkurranse
definitions.translation: (be next in line to) take part in a tough test or competition

examples.no: skulle i ilden foran dommerpanel og publikum
examples.en: was to undergo a tough test before a panel of judges and an audience
